reviewFlags.issue: Israeli pages disagree: E on Wisebuy, A++ on Electroclick and Digital Electric (old scale), A in one spec table. Check the energy label of this model before publishing the class.
Depth differs: 59.9 ס״מ on Wisebuy and Digital Electric, 64.8 ס״מ in an Electroclick spec table. Other pages give 65.2 and 66.5 ס״מ including the door.
Catalog says 65dB, but the Israeli pages give 64 dB. A third-party EU energy label naming this model shows 63 dB, so the sources conflict.
Weight comes from one retailer page only (48.1 kg). A search snippet of a Bosch UK page showed 48.2 kg, which was not fetched.

Importer name and warranty length come from retailer pages only. Electroclick names MA ASPEC with one-year warranty; Digital Electric gives one year as well under a different warranty label. Verify with the importer.
The 205-minute full-program time in the catalog was not found on any fetched page.
Catalog says 65dB; Israeli retailer pages give 64 dB and an EU label snippet showed 63 dB. Verify against the energy label.
Wisebuy gives E (new scale); other pages give A++ (old scale) and one table gives A. Check the model's energy label.
Depth is 59.9 cm on two pages but 64.8 cm in an Electroclick table, and 65.2 or 66.5 cm with the door elsewhere. Confirm before customers measure niches.
Catalog's 205-minute program time was not found on any source.
Importer MA ASPEC and one-year warranty come from retailer pages only; verify with the importer.
